name: Chennai Meenakshi Multispeciality Hospital Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1979, Chennai Meenakshi Multispecialty Hospital Ltd is in the business of providing healthcare services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
CMMHL is a multispeciality hospital that provides multiple health treatments and health care services. Specialists from various fields visit the hospital at shorter notice, to provide medical treatment to the patients

pros: Promoter holding has increased by 21.4% over last quarter.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.91% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.29 Cr.
